reason: Riset accepted tidak memberikan wujud jasmani atau ikonografi yang dapat digambar. c10 mencatat tiadanya representasi awal, c13 menyebut penciptaan bumi/langit/manusia tetapi tidak bentuk atau proses manifestasi visual aktif. rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
